key_highlights: ASX slides as oil hovers near US$100 amid Iran conflict, fuelling RBA rate-hike bets; big four banks fall
Iron ore in sustained downturn – 'drowning, not waving' – pressuring BHP, RIO, FMG
RBA perceived to be 'choosing recession' as business conditions hit weakest since pandemic
Home buyer sentiment collapses; NZ house price crash returns, signalling regional housing stress
Santos gas cartel exposure emerges; NSW power supply and data-centre demand strain energy transition
Gold rallies on geopolitical risk; Forrestania and Manhattan Gold hit milestones
China-Trump tensions escalate, threatening commodity demand and AUD
Qantas $35M payout to fired workers signals ongoing airline sector stress

sectors.trend: Iron ore in structural weakness; China demand softening amid US-China trade friction. Gold counter-cyclical strength offsets some metals weakness.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin pressure. Gold miners (GOLD.AX, NGX.AX, FOR.AX) benefit from safe-haven flows. Uranium (INF.AX) early-stage upside.

sectors.trend: Big four banks fall on rate-hike fears and housing downturn. NAB, CBA, ANZ, WBC under pressure from credit-risk repricing and falling property values.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin upside from higher rates offset by rising NPLs in residential mortgage book. REITs (ICP.AX, SPG.AX) face higher financing costs.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran war; Santos gas cartel exposure creates regulatory and reputational risk. NSW power shortfall and data-centre load growth strain grid.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WDS.AX, XTL.AX face policy risk. Power generators (GPT.AX, IAG.AX) benefit from load growth. LNG exporters (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) see revenue support.

sectors.trend: Business conditions weakest since pandemic; mall retailer closes 25 stores; Qantas $35M payout; car supply crunch lifts insurance premiums.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX, WES.AX, WBC.AX (retail) under pressure. Insurance (CGU.AX, WBC.AX) sees premium tailwinds from vehicle supply crunch.

sectors.trend: Relatively insulated from commodity cycle. ATO vs Big Tech tax dispute may affect tech valuations. Data-centre build-out supports infrastructure spend.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX defensive. Tech exposure via ASX-listed data-centre REITs and infrastructure funds benefits from load growth.

key_themes: Oil spike near US$100 driving inflation scare and RBA hawkish repricing
Iron ore structural weakness tied to China demand and US-China geopolitical risk
Housing downturn: buyer sentiment collapse, NZ crash, credit-risk build in banks
RBA policy dilemma: recession risk vs inflation from energy shock
Energy transition strain: data centres, NSW power shortfall, gas cartel fallout
Gold as geopolitical safe haven; AUD under pressure from China tensions
Business confidence at pandemic lows signalling broad economic slowdown

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price sustained above US$100 (Iran conflict)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic gas/LNG producers; monitor RBA response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced into rate hikes amid recession risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive sectors (REITs, property); favour dividend payers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand collapse / China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and uranium
Monitor NAB.AX, CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX NPL trends; reduce REIT exposure
Avoid SOL.AX near-term; favour WDS.AX, XTL.AX as cleaner energy plays
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners with USD revenue

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on safe-haven and inflation-hedge flows
opportunities.rationale: Gold rallying on Iran war and Trump uncertainty; Forrestania and Manhattan Gold hitting production milestones

opportunities.recommendation: Favour domestic gas/LNG over oil-exposed names amid cartel risk
opportunities.rationale: Santos cartel exposure creates binary regulatory risk; WDS and XTL offer cleaner energy transition exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Recession risk and business confidence at pandemic lows favour defensive sectors
Infini 7.5% uranium discovery in Canada signals sector re-rating; energy security theme

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or hedge iron ore exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'drowning' on China demand weakness and US-China trade friction; structural overhang

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim bank and REIT positions ahead of potential RBA hike
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate-hike bets plus housing downturn pressure NIMs and property valuations simultaneously

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid Santos near-term on cartel/regulatory overhang
defensive_moves.rationale: Gas cartel exposure creates binary downside; reputational and legal risk unresolved
China-USD tensions and commodity weakness pressure AUD; cross-currency risk for global portfolios

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to consolidate lower on oil-driven inflation scare, RBA hawkish repricing, and iron ore weakness. Banks and materials lead declines. Gold and defensives outperform. Volatility elevated on Iran conflict headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious. If RBA is forced into hikes amid recession, a shallow correction in ^AXJO is likely over 6–12 months. Structural themes: energy transition, data-centre demand, and China decoupling reshape sector leadership. Gold and uranium offer asymmetric upside.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement (inflation vs recession trade-off)
Iron ore price trajectory and China stimulus signals

Housing credit data (NAB, CBA NPL trends)
